items.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $79,000 as Zcash records a $500 million ETF haul
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to nearly $77,600 on Tuesday before clawing most of it back, leaving it little changed on the day while zcash gained roughly 43% on the week and Grayscale's new fund crossed half a billion dollars.
